item.title: Metallica’s Kirk Hammett Takes a Tumble Into the Dublin Crowd During ‘Seek & Destroy’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this episode of 'Rock On', where we bring you the latest news from the world of music. And what a story we have for you today. Metallica's Kirk Hammett took an unexpected tumble into the crowd during the band's show at Dublin's Aviva Stadium last Friday. But don't worry, he's okay, and the show went on without a hitch."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to eyewitnesses, Hammett lost his footing on the stage edge and fell into the audience as the band launched into 'Seek & Destroy' in front of approximately 40,000 fans. But the 63-year-old guitarist was back on his feet in no time, missing only a few notes before continuing the performance. And in true rockstar fashion, he even poked fun at himself on social media, sharing a fan-captured video of the fall on Instagram and captioning it 'Slip & Destroy'."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The moment quickly went viral, with fans praising Hammett's ability to laugh off what could have been a serious accident. The Dublin show was part of Metallica's ongoing European tour, which will continue with shows in Glasgow, Cardiff, and London. And later this year, the band will embark on an ambitious 24-date residency at the Las Vegas Sphere, starting on October 1st."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Metallica is one of the most successful rock bands of all time, with over 150 million albums sold worldwide and six number one albums on the Billboard 200 chart. They've won eight Grammy Awards and were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2009. And 'Seek & Destroy', the song Hammett was playing when he fell, is a fan favorite that's been a staple of their live set for over four decades."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of 'Rock On'. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the flip side!"
